tweets: Due to missing access controls, malicious actors can withdraw Ether from a contract account.
Unprotected withdrawal bugs are sometimes caused by unintentionally exposing initialization functions.
In legacy Solidity versions prior to 0.4.22, wrongly naming a constructor function places it in runtime bytecode where anyone can call it.
Implement access controls so Ether withdrawals can be initiated only by authorized parties or as specified.
Inheriting OpenZeppelin Ownable provides an onlyOwner modifier to restrict execution to the authorized owner address.
